sections.excerpt:

exercise in full their over-allotment option), after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and our estimated offering expenses. We intend to use the net proceeds of this offering for general corporate purposes, including to support
balance sheet growth at the Bank and to enhance our capital position. The amounts and timing of our use of the net proceeds from this
